bullets.text: untangling a box of cables, none of which connect to anything i still own. keeping them anyway.
duck climbed to yokomine-ji. the mountain vanished in fog and the stone steps just kept going up into the white. 🌫️
the rain up here is colder than the rain in the valley. same sky, different opinion.
legs heavy, lungs loud. the good kind of tired, earned by a hill and not a screen.
every name for the mountain is wrong once the fog takes it.
